g.text: PASSIVE
silent → resentful
→ unsafe!
ASSERTIVE ★
clear + kind +
firm = SAFE!
AGGRESSIVE
loud → feared
→ errors hide!
DESC SCRIPT
Describe · Express ·
Specify · Consequences
CONFLICT: WIN-WIN
private + listen both +
patient-first fix!
3 STYLES: passive (silent, resentful, unsafe!) · ASSERTIVE (clear + kind + firm —
patients safest!) · aggressive (loud, feared — errors HIDE from shouters!). Exam: "best
response?" = assertive option, always. "I" language + facts + request + respect.
DESC (scripts courage!): Describe facts ("the 10:00 drugs weren't given…") · Express impact
("…I'm worried for the patient and for us…") · Specify need ("…please prioritise meds
rounds — can I help reorganise…?") · Consequences ("…so patients stay safe and we pass
audit"). Private, calm, witnessed if serious.
SPEAKING UP (CUS!): "I'm CONCERNED (wrong dose?)… I'm UNCOMFORTABLE (please recheck)…
this is a SAFETY issue (stopping now, calling senior)!" — graded assertiveness SAVES lives.
CONFLICT STEPS: private room · each story uninterrupted · feelings named · PATIENT-first
frame ("what serves Maame?") · options brainstormed · agreed fix + review date ·
documented. Never corridor shouting, never patient-side battles, never grudges.
BULLYING/LATERAL VIOLENCE: name it ("shouting at me is unacceptable") · record dates/quotes/
witnesses · report (senior → matron → union) · support victims · ZERO tolerance. "Nurses
eat their young" ends with YOUR cohort (PRO-I M6!).
FEEDBACK (SBI!): Situation ("on Tuesday's round…") · Behaviour ("…you presented SBAR
clearly…") · Impact ("…the doctor decided fast — patient safer!"). Praise publicly, correct
privately, always SBI — vagueness ("good job") teaches nothing.
MANTRA: "clear + kind + firm — patients safest with assertive nurses."
